title: Practitioner evidence for a less-first Bun/TypeScript web stack

scope.interpretation: Minimize concepts, files and dependencies while preserving correctness checks.

execution.model_limitation: The process was invoked with explicit gpt-6-astra and medium-reasoning flags, but the JSONL did not expose effective model/reasoning values for independent read-back.

recommendation.default: For server-owned forms, lists and content: Bun + Hono + server HTML; HTMX for fragments, Preact only for rich-state islands, Hono RPC only for typed JSON consumers.
recommendation.alternative: Elysia 1.4 + Eden as one schema-led server/client pair. Retain a working implementation; account for security-only maintenance before new adoption.
recommendation.avoid: Combining both frameworks or multiple contract authorities for the same application boundary.

version_findings.advice: Evaluation candidate; pin and smoke-test the deployed artifact.
Build success alone is not an execution check.
Version-match documentation and do not assume forthcoming features land on 1.4.
Check @elysia versus historical @elysiajs examples; peer ranges not verified here.
Reports and rolling docs are not an end-to-end compatibility certification; Preact reference material was explicitly v10.

practitioner_recommendations.claim: Choose small servers and local feature ownership for simple workflows.
practitioner_recommendations.evidence: Historical Hono/Bun DX reports and content-app migration accounts.

practitioner_recommendations.claim: Use integrated inferred API contracts when TypeScript clients need JSON.
practitioner_recommendations.evidence: Elysia community praise accompanied by integration caveats.

practitioner_recommendations.claim: Keep rich local state in a client component when HTML-attribute logic becomes cumbersome.
practitioner_recommendations.evidence: PhotoQuest islands and Gumroad's different UX requirements.

practitioner_recommendations.claim: Split growing type graphs when measured tooling costs warrant it.
practitioner_recommendations.evidence: Independent Hono experiment and official RPC guidance.

recurring_complaints.recurrence_basis: Separate Hono reports, an experiment, Elysia guard report and official gotchas; not a frequency estimate.

recurring_complaints.theme: Patch/integration changes can break behavior despite apparently successful builds or typing
recurring_complaints.recurrence_basis: Bun artifact regression and Eden custom-fetch error behavior.

recurring_complaints.theme: Rich UI and lifecycle glue can negate simplistic minimalism
recurring_complaints.recurrence_basis: Two distinct projects; PhotoQuest blog and Reddit counted once.
Several participants within one Elysia feedback thread, not cross-thread consensus.

redundant_or_overkill.combination: Hono and Elysia on the same application boundary
redundant_or_overkill.recommendation: Choose one; migration coexistence is an exception.

redundant_or_overkill.combination: Inferred RPC plus a second RPC layer plus duplicate manual DTOs
redundant_or_overkill.recommendation: Use one authoritative contract; retain external API schemas where needed.

redundant_or_overkill.combination: JSON RPC wrapped around ordinary HTMX fragments
redundant_or_overkill.recommendation: Let the browser consume HTML directly.

redundant_or_overkill.combination: HTMX, Preact, Alpine and another renderer owning the same DOM/state
Whole-app client router/cache for isolated widgets
redundant_or_overkill.recommendation: Add only when shared state/navigation needs justify it.

redundant_or_overkill.combination: Large build orchestration or forced single-file application
redundant_or_overkill.recommendation: Start small, retain useful modules, and measure when to add boundaries.

configuration_tips.advice: Strict mode, version alignment, type-only contract imports, status-aware error typing; split or precompile only when needed.
Preserve chained inferred types; align Elysia versions; explicitly choose date and error semantics.
Separate server Hono JSX configuration from Preact JSX configuration.
Handle insertion, duplicate mounts and cleanup; verify lifecycle events against the pinned HTMX major.
Align runtime/types/CI/image pins and execute the built production artifact in smoke checks.
Test runtime boundaries and reject unexpected any; HTML selectors/forms need integration checks beyond JSON types.

replacement_candidates.may_replace: Separate tools performing equivalent basic work
replacement_candidates.retain_until_verified: Specialized plugins, environments, task ordering and caching

replacement_candidates.may_replace: Standalone no-emit type-check step for appropriate projects
replacement_candidates.retain_until_verified: Declaration emitter and editor language service
Rich client components, browser checks and history/error behavior

replacement_candidates.may_replace: Duplicated private TS API wrappers and DTO maintenance
replacement_candidates.retain_until_verified: Runtime validation and external consumer contracts
Preact if library compatibility or richer usage warrants it

replacement_candidates.may_replace: Complex attribute-based state or whole-app SPA solely for a widget
replacement_candidates.retain_until_verified: Server ownership around the widget and lifecycle integration

should_stay: Type checking and meaningful contract/error checks
Runtime validation, authorization and appropriate web security boundaries
Integration/browser tests covering actual interaction and artifact failures
Operational logging and established deployment behavior
Useful modules and a working framework/client pair unless measured migration value exists
Preact where actual client-state needs justify it

llm_productivity.overall_verdict: Not established for the requested stack; structural simplification is plausible, but there is contrary firsthand experience.

dimensions.finding: Content-app migration precedent; no matched agent result.
Migration summaries and built-in tools suggest simplification opportunities, not agent gains.
Fewer client layers can help; island/inference glue adds concepts back.
Inference may detect shape mismatches; any and changed error behavior remain failure modes.
One firsthand author found the HTMX/Alpine approach harder for LLMs than a typed React stack; confounded comparison.

methodology.design: Targeted qualitative review; no representative sampling or vote aggregation.
evidence_rules: Do not generalize a historical defect to a current release without evidence.
Do not use indexed-only Reddit snippets substantively.
Differentiate feature verification, reproduction reports, uncontrolled measurements and design inference.
methodology.cross_checks: Official documentation/releases; direct package metadata retrieval attempted but blocked by DNS.

confidence_definition.high: Primary technical documentation or specific reported reproduction with corroboration; not universal reliability.
confidence_definition.medium: Dated/attributable firsthand account with useful detail, limited transfer or unexecuted experiment.
confidence_definition.low: Unversioned anecdote, date ambiguity, or secondary summary.

limitations: No local benchmark, dependency install or reproduction.
Rolling docs can differ from historical versions.
Migration summaries are secondary and not LLM experiments.
No measured current framework defect-rate comparison.

coverage_gaps.detail: Thread bodies/comments were readable through web retrieval. One comment permalink returned cache miss. Relative/cached dates are not exact dates. No indexed-only Reddit result is substantive evidence.
Direct request returned HTTP 429; indexed comparison/production praise excluded from conclusions.
Search discovered a model-choice table; direct page returned cache miss. No adoption, accuracy or productivity inference used.

Read-only urllib metadata requests for bun/1.4.4, elysia/1.4.30, @elysia/eden/1.4.10, @elysiajs/eden/1.4.9 and hono/4.13.5 failed DNS resolution. Official docs/releases used instead; no dependency graph or peer-range claims verified.
No Discord/Slack login, contact, posting or private discussions. Public GitHub framework discussion used.
